items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: I actually played prior to that with Quincy Jones’ big band which was interesting too. Jerome [Richardson] was on that band.

ctx.x: No, I functioned very well, Monk, in New York. I had a nice apartment up on West 72nd Street with French doors and a big formal dining room and all that stuff, and I wound up buying a Mercedes and storing it in the garage down there for trips on the weekends, and my mom lived up in Connecticut so I was — on the weekends if I didn’t have anything I’d drive up there. But there was a lot of work. There was a lot of things. Early on I did subs on “The Ed Sullivan Show” and then of course I played for a while on “The…
Was that the band that did the European thing?
